entries.250776e178f01da3: It consists of RICOH COMPANY,LTD., 229 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and 17 associated companies (as of March 31, 2026). Development is mainly handled by the company; production is carried out by the company and by domestic and overseas production-related companies integrated with its production system; and sales and services extend to about 200 countries and regions worldwide, covering Japan, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Greater China and Asia and other regions. Domestic sales are handled by RICOH JAPAN CORPORATION, and sales in the United States by RICOH USA, INC. and others; RICOH JAPAN CORPORATION and RICOH USA, INC. are subsidiaries whose revenue accounts for more than 10% of consolidated revenue. Development and design of multifunction printers and other products are handled by Etoria Co., Ltd., a joint venture formed with Toshiba Tec Corporation in July 2024 (RICOH's voting-rights ownership ratio: 80.7%). The number of employees is 75,635.

entries.ecf70b2fbc5d9543: Under the Medium-Term Management Strategy '26, launched in April 2026, it changed from a fixed 3-year plan to an annual rolling approach looking 5 years ahead. It aims to be an integrator that combines its own and other companies' products, services and software in customers' “workplaces” to contribute to customers' competitive advantage and differentiation. Its basic policies are 3: improving profitability through accumulation of “stock” arising from ongoing transactions with customers, continuous review of the cost structure, and revitalization of human resources. In the Office Printing Business, it will secure a stable earnings base through Etoria by using technology with superior environmental performance, and in the Commercial and Industrial Printing Business it will work on creating new growth businesses leveraging inkjet technology. It will also use strategic M&A, centered on the Workplace Experience and Process Automation areas.
entries.ed9cabf4fd474438: This business manufactures and sells thermal products, such as thermal paper used at manufacturing, distribution, logistics and medical sites, as well as precision components mainly for the automotive industry and automation equipment and inspection equipment for manufacturers. It has 2 businesses: Thermal Business and Industrial Products Business. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥106,232 million, down 5.3% from ¥112,192 million in the previous year. The company attributes the decline to the impact of the transfer of the Optical Business in the previous fiscal year, and states that excluding this impact, revenue was on a par with the previous year.
